content: अविमुक्त {%a.%} Unloosed, not quitted or let go. .{@-क्तः@} The Lord of Benares; प्रीतोऽविमुक्तो भगवांस्तस्मै वरमदाद्भवः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 66. 29</ls>. .{@-क्तम्@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a Tīrtha or sacred place near Benares, or Benares itself; न विमुक्तं शिवाभ्यां यदविमुक्तं ततो विदुः. .²2 The space between the chin and the head. .{@-कः@} <ab>N.</ab> of a plant (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>कुसरी</ns>).
